journey.name: usdt bridge amount errors
journey.description: Use an onboarded USDT wallet and a gateway fixture that rejects outbound quotes and inbound estimates with xchain_amount_too_small. No payment is submitted. The error describes live bridge costs rather than inventing a fixed network minimum.

actions.action: Enable USDT in the introductory sheet or Settings, General, Payments before starting this flow.

Open USDT Send, select Tron and enter a valid external Tron address. Enter 3.5 USDT and continue. Verify the amount screen remains visible, payment review does not open, and the error says Amount too small to cover bridge costs. Try a larger amount.

Return to USDT Receive, select Tron and enter an expected deposit amount of 3.5 USDT. Continue. Verify the same actionable error is shown and no deposit QR is presented. Verify the error does not claim that the provider's advertised minimum guarantees acceptance.
Change the fixture to provide a valid quote or estimate, increase the amount and continue. Verify the error clears and the flow advances. Stop before approving a payment or sharing a deposit request.

Use a fixture that returns amount_too_small with min_usd_cents 200 for a 1 USDT Solana quote. Verify the amount screen shows Minimum amount is $2.00, not a decimal-format error. Remove the limit and verify the message still describes the route minimum without inventing a number.

Repeat with amount_too_large and max_usd_cents 10000, then without a limit. Verify the route maximum is described and any supplied limit is displayed. Return amount_exceeds_liquidity and verify the message suggests another network or trying later. Repeat using MAX and verify no payment is submitted.
After a rejected quote, edit the amount. Verify the old error clears immediately before another quote is requested.

Return HTTP 429 rate_limited from a quote. Repeatedly try Continue and MAX, and trigger a wallet refresh during the next minute. Verify the app retains an actionable retry message and the fixture receives no further quote, MAX, send or wallet-refresh calls during that cooldown. Retry after the minute ends and verify a new request is allowed. A blocked retry must not extend the cooldown or automatically submit a payment.

Use a delayed quote fixture. Start Continue and then MAX separately; while each is loading, try digit taps, Delete and a long press on Delete. Verify the amount stays unchanged, the controls stay busy and no second quote starts. After completion, verify editing works again. Do not approve a payment.
